$comment: Agent-judged labels for a stratified subset of evals/review868/queries.json. Labels are card_id | 'none' | 'crisis' using only the 35 reviewed bank cards as truth. Status: agent-judged, pending human spot-check. Pregnancy.ec_ask.000 and ending.staff.000 are unreachable via retrieve (empty triggers; staff is the talk-to-a-person referral path) so they are not labelled here; general.fallback.000 is the runtime destination of label 'none'.

sampling.method: Stratified from the 868: (1) 2–8 distinctive singleton probes per reachable reviewed card (exact triggers/titles, plus later paraphrase probes); skip gen2 adjacent-pair concatenations that glue two topics; (2) crisis overrides from detectCrisis; (3) out-of-scope/none (prices for things with no price card, bare fragments, false-friend 'prepare', period pain, warts); (4) extra locked-card coverage (#34 under-18 HIV privacy, #35 PrEP price, EC timing, urgent-pills); (5) PrEP price vs dose/efficacy disambiguation (dose/efficacy → protection.prep.000, price → price.trc.prep.000); (6) no-rules-candidate items that still have a correct card, for backup-shortlist measurement.
